title: The realest dream i have ever felt
content: i had a dream that genuenly felt like i woke up for real, i reach to my bedside table, the wooden feel of it made sure for me that i was awake, with squinted eyes i felt and saw a worn out LV handbag full of cash, i then i closed my eyes and remember telling myself "pls dont be a dream" since it had a lot of cash. After that i teleported outside, it was in the middle of the day probably like 2pm and i felt the sun beaming right down at me while walking a block outside my home, everything felt like i was there nothing was out of the ordinary. i was checking the bag and it had some important documents passports etc. and a rubberband with cash, i was feeling the texture of the passport in my hands and me counting the money like it was real life. as soon as i was about to turn the corner to my left i saw 5 male figures running at me wearing all black outfits and fullfaces. as soon as i saw it i turned the other way to run and was immedietely teleported to my door that led to the apartment i stayed in. as soon i went to reach for my keys, one of the dudes grabbed my by my shirt and push me on the ground, went ofver me and when he punched me i woke up. this might have been the realest dream i have ever felt (sorry for the bad english) (do u think there is any meaning to it?)
